src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    key_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8)]
    gray_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in key_cells), max(r for r, c in key_cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in key_cells), max(c for r, c in key_cells)
    key = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    rotated = [list(row) for row in zip(*key[::-1])]
    gr0, gr1 = min(r for r, c in gray_cells), max(r for r, c in gray_cells)
    gc0, gc1 = min(c for r, c in gray_cells), max(c for r, c in gray_cells)
    scale_r = (gr1 - gr0 + 1) // len(rotated)
    scale_c = (gc1 - gc0 + 1) // len(rotated[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in gray_cells:
        rr, cc = (r - gr0) // scale_r, (c - gc0) // scale_c
        out[r][c] = rotated[rr][cc]
    return out
'''
prog.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
prog.write_text(src)
print(prog)
